standard-dialogue-after-making-friends-w.player: Snowflake and My Arm are ruling the town together, and now I've built them a special fire, they can grow goutweed there.

standard-dialogue-after-making-friends-w.npc: So My Arm taught Weiss the farming knowledge of the Stronghold trolls. Now Stronghold trolls can be given firemaking knowledge from Weiss, like I promised.

standard-dialogue-after-making-friends-w.player: Snowflake gave me a book containing all the information she could find from Odd Mushroom's notes.

standard-dialogue-after-making-friends-w.npc: Give it to Burntmeat. He can teach trolls what they want to know from it.

standard-dialogue-after-making-friends-w.text: If the player does not have the Weiss fire notes:

steps.player: Hopefully Snowflake will give me another one.

standard-dialogue-after-making-friends-w.text: If the player has a copy of the Weiss fire notes:

steps.player: Now that My Arm has taught the Weiss trolls what he knows about farming, here's a book containing what the Weiss trolls know about firemaking.

steps.npc: Odd Mushroom invented lots of clever stuff with Snowflake. Might be handy for Stronghold trolls.

steps.text: The troll looks at the scientific notes.
The troll wrinkles his forehead in thought.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Yeah, lotsa learnings here. Very clever stuff. We oughta reward you.

options.text: Don't give me more burnt meat.

steps.player: Don't give me more burnt meat. I've been here before, and you gave me a load of burnt meat.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Silly human pretends he don't like Burntmeat's lovely burnt meat! But okay, Burntmeat will not make any more for you. Ever.

steps.player: Ever? You're never ever going to give me burnt meat again?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: No more burnt meat from Burntmeat, ever. Wolfbone here has made reward for you instead.

steps.npc: Yes, I have learnt a lot here from my friend Burntmeat, and he has let me prepare a reward for you myself.

steps.text: As you no longer wish to receive burnt meat from Burntmeat, Wolfbone presents you with a reward instead.
a full inventory of burnt meat
You hear a suspicious munching sound from the direction of Burntmeat.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Burntmeat got feeling you no like Burntmeat's burnt meat. Burntmeat made some for you before, an' you not seem grateful. So Burntmeat will not make any more for you. Ever.

steps.player: Ever? You're never ever going to give me burnt meat again?

standard-dialogue-after-quest-and-after-.player: Snowflake and My Arm are ruling the town together, and now I've built them a special fire, they can grow goutweed there.

standard-dialogue-after-quest-and-after-.npc: I plan to stay here, in the Stronghold, with my friend Burntmeat, but it good to hear of my home. Thank you.

standard-dialogue-after-quest-and-after-.speaker: Burntmeat
standard-dialogue-after-quest-and-after-.text: Stronghold trolls not all that interested in firemaking, after all, but t'anks for bringing book anyway. It taste lovely.
